verses.1: To be glorified, let there be songs of praise to God from all the lands.
verses.2: Chant with honor of his name; sing in praise of his song.
verses.3: Say to God, “What a wonderful thing your actions are! With all your strength, you can overcome your enemies.”
verses.4: All the earth shall worship you, and they shall praise your name. They will sing your praises.
verses.5: Go and see the works of God’s greatness among human beings.
verses.6: It turned the sea into a river. They walked across it on foot, and they were happy there.
verses.7: In his greatness, Moses had eyes that could see forever. He could see the nations from afar, and he knew what they were doing.
verses.8: Bless our people, our God, and let them hear His voice.
verses.9: He gave us a soul in life, but he did not let our feet be bound by any chains.
verses.10: For in our poverty, God has made us rich as if we were filled with gold.
verses.11: Have you brought us into the place where you placed Mu’akha among our offerings?
verses.12: You made us ride on our heads in the fire and in the water. Then you brought us out into the wilderness.
verses.13: I will enter your house in haste, so that I may bless you with my protection.
verses.14: When my words and my speech were spoken in my suffering.
verses.15: I will go up into the mountains. I will go there with a herd of sheep. I will spend the day there, with my sheep.
verses.16: Let them hear and learn from all the works of God that He has done for my soul.
verses.17: To him I called out, and he answered me from beneath my feet.
verses.18: Oh, if I were to see it in my heart, it would not be heard by Adonai.
verses.19: Now, God has heard my prayers. He has listened to my supplications.
verses.20: Blessed is God, who has not rejected my prayers and whose kindness remains with me.
